label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input 'param' flows into 'filter' string via 'safe'. Although partial escaping ('\', '*') is applied, it is insufficient for LDAP injection prevention (operators like ')(', '&', '|' remain unescaped). Resolved sink value '(uid=<prefix><safe>)' depends on attacker-controlled 'param'.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from request parameter
Filter constructed via string concatenation with unsanitized user data
LDAP search executes the constructed filter containing user input
